name: Doinaka Girls Utopia
storyline:
"A gloomy loser like me was never going to get a girlfriend... I'm destined to spend the rest of my life alone."

After losing the brutal battle for love in the big city and nursing a broken heart, Shuji Katase decides to leave it all behind and move in with his grandmother in the countryside.
He just wants to take life slow, surrounded by nature...
(Though, if he could finally get a girlfriend, that'd be even better!)

Upon arriving in his sleepy new hometown, Shuji is enthusiastically welcomed by Chinatsu Aikawa, an innocent country beauty who secretly feels self-conscious about rural life.

"Y-You're... from the city, aren't you!?
I'll show you around! It's only natural—I'm a local, after all!"

As it turns out, the village has been shrinking for years, and there are practically no young men left.

Wait... does that mean being a young guy alone makes me popular here...?

Before long, Chinatsu's friends—Ririka Kirino and Amane Nanahara—join the picture.

"So you're that guy from the city? Hm... Honestly? You don't look like much."
"Come on, Ririka... You know, the moment she heard a boy was finally coming to town, she got all dressed up and rushed over."

Pure-hearted, sheltered, and far too easy to fluster, the girls can't hide their curiosity—or the unmistakable affection in their eyes for Shuji.

"S-Shuji-kun... do you have a girlfriend?"

Can a gloomy, socially awkward virgin whose "time without a girlfriend" equals his age really turn his life around just by moving to the countryside!?

As one breathtaking, busty beauty after another falls head over heels for him, Shuji discovers that the quiet backwoods might just be the utopia he'd always dreamed of.
